steps.what: Monitor security employees' work against quality standards, deadlines and procedures
Clarify deviations and give proportionate corrective guidance

tasks.design: Retain direct supervision and contextual discussion with employees. Existing {DOCS} procedures support the check; this design introduces no behaviour scoring or assumed continuous surveillance feed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Adherence must be judged in the circumstances of actual security work.
tasks.enabler_now: No relevant validated operational supervision saving appears in the digest.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing justified adaptation from poor practice.
tasks.human_edge: Observe fairly, hear explanations and coach appropriate action.
tasks.altitude: Supervisory authority and observation time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Check whether procedures fit actual post conditions

evidence.claim: Operational supervision remains human work in this design; desk-work tools do not establish a direct observation saving.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor observation and corrective discussion, excluding guard execution and disciplinary processes.
Supervisor produces observed deviations in s1 with all observation time retained; no structured behaviour feed is assumed.
Review native procedure access first. Unchanged supervision adds zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which apparent deviations require contextual discussion before action?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70+30=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Observation and employee discussion retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise employees on problems and complaints

steps.what: Advise employees handling problems or complaints from affected persons

tasks.design: Keep advice and de-escalation judgement with the supervisor. Existing {DOCS} procedures support the conversation without replacing interpretation of a live complaint.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe advice depends on incomplete accounts and the affected person's circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: No validated automated complaint-advice capability is supplied in this digest.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing safety, fairness and immediate practical constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Listen, recognise escalation needs and guide proportionate action.
tasks.altitude: Complaint advice and escalation responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Communicate context and identify when supervisor input is needed

evidence.claim: A procedure reference is insufficient to replace contextual advice on live complaints; no saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor advice, excluding employee complaint handling and affected-person time.
Employee supplies the account during the counted conversation; no structured incident code or automatic enforcement decision is assumed.
Use native procedure access first. Unchanged advice adds no upkeep.
research_questions: Which complaint features require immediate supervisor judgement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Contextual advice remains intact; no guard or complainant time enters the saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recruit, interview and hire security staff

steps.what: Recruit security personnel and review application evidence
Interview candidates about security work and required competence
Choose suitable security personnel and confirm the hiring recommendation

tasks.design: Configure {ATS} vacancy checklists and application views to reduce repeated document navigation. The supervisor still reads the evidence, selects interviewees, conducts interviews and decides the recommendation; no model ranking or automatic rejection is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scattered application evidence increases navigation during recruitment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native application records and consistent vacancy checklists can consolidate evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing competence and suitability fairly from incomplete evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Probe experience and make accountable selection judgements.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated navigation, with unchanged interviewing and hiring authority.

reach.task: Maintain vacancy requirements and candidate records
reach.learn: Separate evidence completeness from selection judgement

evidence.claim: Native application consolidation is a plausible configuration; the digest supplies no security recruitment case or measured saving.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor recruitment, interview and recommendation time. Recruitment-team contract administration and candidate time are excluded and unchanged.

Supervisor confirms vacancy criteria and evidence requirements within s1's retained 28 hours. Candidates supply applications through existing routes; no new candidate form burden is assumed and missing evidence stays visibly missing.
Test native records and views first. No eligibility, ranking or suitability decision is made by code; supervisor judgement remains in retained time.
Three focal hours for checklist upkeep and two recruitment-team hours for record correction are additional. National rules and local hiring authority remain applicable.
unknowns: Native record features and consultation requirements
research_questions: Does consolidation reduce navigation after checklist capture and record corrections?

already_counted.description: Vacancy criteria capture, evidence review and shortlist judgement

incremental.description: Vacancy checklist upkeep and evidence exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=28+45+20=93, gross=7, focal upkeep=3, net=4. High assumes 20% less recruitment-stage navigation with no shorter evidence judgement; low retains all navigation when applications are fragmented plus upkeep. Interview and recommendation retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign staff to security posts and patrols

steps.what: Define post or patrol coverage and verify staff assignment constraints
Match security personnel to posts or patrols against verified constraints
Resolve operational exceptions and confirm post or patrol assignments

tasks.design: Configure a rules-based roster in {HCM} from the supervisor's verified coverage brief. It proposes post allocations without predicting behaviour; the supervisor handles site-specific risks, unresolved gaps and final assignments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual matching repeats checks of availability, qualifications and working-time constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Constraint-based scheduling with planner control exists today; operational post suitability still needs supervisor judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Changing conditions, unexpected absence and site familiarity not captured by formal constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether a technically valid assignment is safe in current conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less roster matching, with unchanged operational command.

reach.learn: Keep availability and site requirements accurate without employee profiling

evidence.claim: ORTEC Workforce generates schedules using labour-law and collective-agreement constraints while planners keep final control; this supports roster matching rather than autonomous operational command.
The proposed post-allocation saving is an unmeasured scenario for stable coverage with verified inputs.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor planned post allocation, excluding live incident command and guard execution. Other rostering tasks must not count the same assignment action again.

Supervisor produces post/time coverage, required qualifications, permitted pairings and current operational constraints in s1. Staff and personnel administration maintain availability and qualification expiry records; s1's full 30 hours include verification and missing-field capture.
Test native roster configuration first. Missing qualifications, uncertain availability or conflicting rules yield an unresolved gap for manual allocation, never a guessed valid assignment.

Six additional focal hours cover rule updates and roster audits; three staff-administration hours cover additional availability and credential corrections. National staff-consultation requirements and data access need local confirmation.
unknowns: Quality of qualification and availability records
research_questions: Can planned matching save time after data capture, operational review and rule upkeep?

already_counted.description: Constraint verification and assignment brief capture
Operational exceptions and exact assignment confirmation

incremental.description: Roster rule updates and assignment audits
Additional availability and credential record correction

approvals.approved_version: Exact staff, post/patrol, times, constraint versions and unresolved gaps; changed availability or allocation voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+0+30=60, gross=40, focal upkeep=6, net=34. High assumes stable planned coverage and genuinely manual constraint matching today; low retains manual matching during frequent operational changes plus upkeep. Constraint capture and operational decisions retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Planned roster matching and application navigation may shrink; live supervision, complaint advice and personnel decisions remain human.
reach: Agree accurate post constraints with security guards
Coordinate record ownership with recruitment specialists
role.ambitious_version: A security supervisor who spends less time matching roster fields while retaining operational command and direct staff support.
